notes.title: Blightstone Joins Steam Next Fest – Play the Demo!
notes.content:
Heroes, the time has come! Blightstone is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and that means you can dive into the fray with our playable demo!

[h1]Meet Your Heroes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/af042793275a777baf015106f71f0f59c9f73fcf.jpg[/img]

In this demo, you'll get to command a trio of fearless adventurers, each bringing unique skills to help you survive the Blight:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/633f58d2e9774cd7859793c753b4302ea83221b5.png[/img]

A powerhouse in close combat, this warrior thrives in the thick of battle. Charge headfirst into danger, unleash an Uppercut to knock enemies senseless, or share a drink… but only if you're ready for the consequences!

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1888948375661195317]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/1c716a6d39c426d006845f5df8b5060d7de87adb.png[/img]

The master of ranged combat and deadly traps. Set the perfect Trap to control the battlefield, then unleash a Bolt Shot to take down enemies from a safe distance.

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1887127009215553896]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/35229178a844a6320959b976320a3163678d026c.png[/img]

A wielder of raw magic, capable of turning the tide of battle with devastating spells. The Arcane Beam can cut through enemies with precision, while other arcane tricks will keep foes at bay.
Your Challenge Awaits

[url=https://x.com/blightstonegame/status/1890398833542046041]Brief Overview Video Character[/url]

You'll also have the chance to unlock a special character, but we'll let you discover that on your own—no spoilers!

The Blightstone demo isn't just about surviving—you’ll have a pair of objectives to complete if you want to finish the experience 100%. Will you push through the corruption and uncover what lies ahead?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311860/a53630b747e1520fca10e0bf5201607eb6bcf93c.jpg[/img]

The world of Blightstone is ruthless, ever-changing, and full of choices. Will you be the one to break the cycle?

Download the demo now and let the battle begin! ⚔️💀
